reason: Built OUTSIDE lib/format.ts, at generation or analysis time, with no reader unit preference in scope. Same architectural fact that made PACE-UNITS-01 unfixable at its producer: by the time the app renders, there is no number left to convert. Fixing these needs the preference threaded to the producer or the number stored beside the string, which is UNITS-PROSE-01, not this commit.
